$comment: Schema 2. Fill the shared template; see doc/online_docs/bioreactors/templates/guide.json. UNIT-BASIS ASSUMPTION: The literal 1000.0 factors in model.kinetics.rule_graph growth-associated uptake expressions are unverified conversions, not established arbitrary fit multipliers. They would convert umol to nmol if the yields were expressed in million cells/umol; the paper instead prints an ambiguous nmol-cells/nmol basis. In the ammonia rule, 0.068 * growth * 1000.0 implicitly treats coefficients.growth_demand.NH3 as umol/(10^6 cell), whereas Table B1 prints mol/(10^6 cell). The correct source prefix is unresolved; do not interpret either conversion as paper-verified. These factors are separate from the explicitly arbitrary 6x lactate and 8x ammonia corrections. Numerical values are retained pending source clarification; see source_manifest.json coefficient_basis_audit.
